hypothesis_status_before_timing: The short TPU check found compact/full-prefix ratios of 0.795 sequential, 1.413 behavior and 0.828 joint. The joint primary screen is expected to be difficult; retain all negative results. This study also tests whether the wide-branch layout improvement persists.
limitations: Fixed weak 9x9 model, float32/highest execution, no MCTS or training.
The first timing stream extends the short qualification stream; the next three streams and all four orders are fixed before launch.
Full-prefix, exact copied dense decoder and compact decoder are compared contemporaneously. Python metadata ownership is unchanged.
Initial zero carry allocation is charged to compilation/warmup. Retained outputs remain on device and are drained inside measured intervals; no buffers are donated.
Split base/delta attention changes floating-point evaluation order. Exact action/state checks apply on each host before timing and every repetition.
Logical device tensor sizes and compiler byte estimates are not measured HBM traffic. Module occupancy does not establish MFU.
Known-policy execution has both actual draws. Learned behavior has less information.
Neither a gain over dense execution nor a gain versus a slower cached sequential control establishes an improvement over the fastest full-prefix mode.
Cold native history replay and new-process reconstruction are narrower than distributed cached-rollout checkpoint recovery.
order_balance: Each compact mode precedes and follows its same-mode dense and full-prefix controls twice.

primary_speed_criterion.metric: Complete equal-work packet-loop wall time using the slowest host per mode.

stopping_rule: One attempt. Any event/state/cache-metadata mismatch, process failure or budget excess prevents speed promotion. Preserve all evidence.
